title: docs(idd-overview-appendix): document consolidating multiple same-root-cause holds into one decision
body:
<!-- idd-skill-authoring-publication: target=target-f3a85ec79af9696d; anchor=kurone-kito/idd-skill#3072; set=set-78da6c7a029eaeae; session=claude-idd-authoring-2ffe0e53bd35; token=pub-6bbff20b9ccbea9b -->

## Background

Field feedback (gist round 16, a private adopter repository) reported a
process-level gap: during a multi-day re-import run, five separate
tracks independently discovered, one at a time over roughly 24 hours,
that they shared one common missing foundation piece -- each hold
correctly used this repository's own Hold/needs-decision/
operator-hearing convention individually, but resolving one hold at a
time meant a new fact surfaced only after the human had already answered
the prior, narrower question. The eventual fix that stopped the cycle
(audit the full commit range touching the shared files once, get one
sign-off on the complete classified list) would have avoided all five
round-trips had it been the documented first move instead of the fifth.

`.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`'s "Hold /
suspend" section (lines 57-88) is the sole authoritative owner of the
Hold/needs-decision escalation convention in this repository -- the same
file that owns the sibling "Upstream-candidate escalation" pattern
immediately below it. No existing mention of a hold-consolidation rule
was found anywhere in that section, the rest of this file, or a
targeted search across the other phase instruction files. This is a
process-level gap, not a code-level one -- no specific file/line beyond
this instructions file applies.

**Ceiling constraint**: this file is part of `bundle-core`, loaded
alongside every phase bundle including `bundle-work-phase` (currently at
98.80% of its context-ceiling notice threshold per `node
scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check`). The closed governance roadmap `#3026`
found no active work that creates headroom in this corpus
("re-packaging moves bytes between surfaces; it does not remove them").
This addition must therefore be byte-neutral or better against the
bundles that include this file.

## Proposed change

Add one short new paragraph to `idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`'s
"Hold / suspend" section (after "Needs-decision claim release" reads
naturally, but the exact placement is the implementer's call), stating
an explicit consolidation rule: when a second hold discovered in the
same work session traces to the same root file or dependency as an
earlier hold from that session (even a hold on a different issue), pause
further per-issue escalation and instead audit the complete scope of the
shared root cause once, bringing one consolidated decision to the human
-- rather than resolving each newly-discovered layer independently and
re-escalating per layer.

Because this file has no spare headroom (see Background), the new
paragraph must be offset within the same file: identify and tighten (not
delete the substance of) an equivalent or greater amount of verbose or
redundant prose elsewhere in `idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md` in
the same change, so the file's net byte count does not increase. Do the
same in this file's canonical `idd-template/` source and regenerate the
live copy with `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply` in the same commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- `idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`'s "Hold / suspend" section
  states the consolidation rule described above in one short new
  paragraph (a few sentences, not a new subsection with worked
  examples).
- `wc -c idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`
  after the change is less than or equal to its value before the change
  (byte-neutral or a net reduction).
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` reports every currently-passing
  bundle that includes this file at a utilization no higher than its
  value immediately before this change (in particular,
  `bundle-work-phase`'s utilization must not increase).
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes overall (the generated
  `.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md` matches
  its `idd-template/` canonical source).

## Candidate files

- `idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 3 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented. The consolidation rule
itself is a small, well-evidenced addition, but finding a genuine,
equal-or-greater trim elsewhere in an already-tight file without losing
real content is a judgment call that may need more than one attempt._
